title: What the Cooperative Warrants and What It Hands Back under Custom Application and Field Services
content:
The warranty a plan carries under Custom Application and Field Services, and the field records the member receives, are both set by the programme the plan is written on.

**The warranty.** On four programmes the cooperative warrants that the pass was completed to the label rate, and on one of those four it warrants completion to the label rate together with rework. On the two prescription programmes the warranty is instead that the product was applied within the prescription tolerance.

**The records.** Guidance records are the machine's own record of the pass. An as-applied map is a map delivered to the member after each pass. A programme may provide the guidance records without delivering an as-applied map.

| Programme | What the cooperative warrants | Guidance records provided | As-applied map delivered after each pass |
|---|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | the pass is completed to the label rate | No | No |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | the pass is completed to the label rate | Yes | No |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | the pass is completed to the label rate, with rework | Yes | Yes |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | the product is applied within the prescription tolerance | Yes | Yes |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | the product is applied within the prescription tolerance | Yes | Yes |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | the pass is completed to the label rate | Yes | Yes |

Read across the table, the three positions are distinct. The Per-Acre Custom Application is the one programme that hands back neither the guidance records nor a map. The Season Commitment Application Plan hands back the guidance records but no map. The remaining four hand back both.
